manuscript.abstract: We present a computer-vision method for detecting abnormal behaviour of turkeys in commercial barns. A multi-object tracker follows individual birds in top-view video; video-level statistics predict per-tracklet decision thresholds without per-video manual tuning, and abnormal events (piling, huddling, prolonged immobility) are flagged for stockperson review. On a multi-barn benchmark the method matches an oracle per-video tuned baseline while requiring no manual threshold setting.

fingerprint.core_problem: abnormal behaviour detection from barn video
